paper_metadata.title: Multiparametric MRI changes persist beyond recovery in concussed adolescent hockey players

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study provides a clear description of the target population (adolescent hockey players) and recruitment setting. However, it uses a small convenience sample (n=17) from specific leagues, and there is no information on the total number of eligible players or the participation rate, which increases the risk of selection bias.
